_readme: Source data for the three README hero charts rendered by scripts/generate_asset_svgs.py. Every value here must resolve to a committed table or a cited CI run (AGENTS.md 8.7). Update this file from the measurement, then re-run the generator -- never hand-edit the SVGs.

meta.note: Three panels, one host, one commit, one harness. The random-lookup panel is a measured loss to HashSet and is published as such.

meta.host: reference host -- Intel i9-12900F, 24 threads, 30 MiB L3, Linux 6.8
meta.config: EXPANSE_BENCH_THREADS="1,4,16", 500 ms windows; one writer thread (full duty or deadline-paced), N readers on try_get over a 2x keyspace

meta.source: crates/expanse/examples/keyspace_density.rs --json; the mechanism is docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3.5 and the original sweep docs/benchmarks/hot_comparison/METHODOLOGY.md §9.4
meta.instrument: mem_used() deterministic byte accounting — host-independent; no wall clock
meta.generator: XorShift64(0x0DDB_1A5E_5EED_0001), each draw masked to the keyspace width; same seed at every width
meta.lambda: N / 2^(bits - 48): mean population of a 2-byte-prefix expanse once the top two key bytes saturate
meta.census: ExpanseStats per flavor at three cells; node_bytes is the per-form byte attribution and its total equals mem_used; branch_depth_histogram[6] counts cascaded 2-byte expanses, [5] cascaded sub-expanses below them
meta.seed_sensitivity: the census cells re-drawn under a second XorShift64 seed; the delta is generator variance at fixed λ

meta.what: the same sweep with LEAF_CAP changed from 32 to 48 by a build-time patch of crates/expanse/src/types.rs (`pub const LEAF_CAP: usize = 48;`), nothing else changed; a control, not a shipped configuration
